verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a CLI built to be run by other AI agents, with JSON output on every command, stable exit codes and env-var key auth. An agent can therefore provision isolated micro-VM agents or Linux desktop 'computers' through the CLI/SDK (idempotent `provision`), send messages and wait for replies, and read agent disks through the Files API. However, nothing documents a direct execute-code-and-return-output primitive or a programmatic teardown/delete, so the full sandbox loop is only partly shown. missing for 10: an explicit code-execution API returning stdout/results, a documented destroy/teardown command or endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an unattended end-to-end run.
